I'll start by reading the spec and every on-disk module the brief names so `learn.js` matches the real APIs, data shapes, and CSS classes.Next I’ll pull §8 of the build plan and the live APIs in `progress.js`, `shell.js`, `svg.js`, and `uiModal.js`.I have the skeleton APIs. Next I’ll inspect real chapter and glossary records plus progress helpers so the renderer matches live data.I have the live data shapes and APIs. Next I’ll write `learn.js` as a single ES5 IIFE that matches `shell.js` and degrades on missing widgets, diagrams, and terms.I’ll tighten a few real issues: `esc()` must actually wrap data-derived text, unknown section types should warn once, and widget `mount` needs to treat a `false` return as unavailable.`learn.js` is in place as a single ES5 IIFE on `window.HRL_LEARN`. No commands were run (per the no-shell constraint). ### 1. Exported API ```js HRL_LEARN.renderPath() HRL_LEARN.renderChapter(chapterId) HRL_LEARN.renderGlossary() HRL_LEARN.openTerm(slug) HRL_LEARN.scrollToTier(tierKey) ``` `renderPath()` puts `data-tier=""` on each `.tier-accordion` so `HRL_SHELL.showView('path', { scrollToTier: 'rookie' })` can find it. ### 2. `HRL_INTERACTIVE.mount` — Chunk 8b must match this ```js HRL_INTERACTIVE.mount(widgetName, container, opts, onComplete) ``` - `widgetName` — string (`section.widget`) - `container` — a dedicated `.widget-mount` node (heading/intro stay outside it) - `opts` — `section.opts || {}` - `onComplete` — always a function; call it when the learner finishes so the chapter progress bar advances Optional probes (used if present, never required): ```js HRL_INTERACTIVE.has(widgetName) // boolean HRL_INTERACTIVE.widgets[widgetName] // function or { mount: fn } ``` If `has(name)` is false, `mount` returns `false`, `mount` throws, or `HRL_INTERACTIVE` is missing, the reader shows a `.empty-state` and does not throw. ### 3. `HRL_GLOSSARY` fields actually read | Field | Shape | |---|---| | `slug` | string | | `term` | string | | `definition` | string | | `aliases` | array of strings (optional) | | `chapter` | chapter id string, or array of ids | | `chapters` | array of ids (optional extra) | | `diagram.svg` | builder name | | `diagram.opts` | options object | Helpers used: `bySlug(slug)`, `all()`, and `terms` as a fallback. `short` and `related` are not rendered. ### 4. CSS classes emitted that are **not** in `styles.css` `path-summary`, `path-badges`, `path-tiers`, `tier-ahead`, `tier-head-main`, `tier-head-name`, `tier-head-blurb`, `tier-head-count`, `tier-head-ahead`, `chapter-card-num`, `chapter-card-title`, `chapter-card-sub`, `chapter-header-copy`, `chapter-hero`, `chapter-hero-img`, `chapter-title`, `chapter-subtitle`, `chapter-objectives-block`, `chapter-objectives-lead`, `chapter-sections`, `widget-mount`, `term-plain`, `compare-grid`, `compare-col`, `steps-list`, `divisionnote-scroll`, `glossary-search`, `glossary-az`, `glossary-az-link`, `glossary-az-idle`, `glossary-results`, `glossary-letter-group`, `glossary-entry`, `glossary-chapters`, `glossary-popover` Compare columns and A–Z jumps also use inline layout so they work without new CSS (two-column `auto-fit` grid that stacks under ~16rem). Ahead tiers get `opacity: 0.78` inline. `divisionnote` tables sit in an `overflow-x: auto` wrapper. ### 5. Calls into other modules **`HRL_PROGRESS`** - `getPlacement()` → `{ done, recommendedTier, ... }` - `nextChapter()` → chapter id or `null` - `overallProgress()` → `{ total, complete, pct }` - `tierProgress(tierKey)` → `{ total, complete, pct }` - `getChapter(chapterId)` → `{ visited, completed, bestScore, ... }` - `hasBadge(id)` — chapter badges are `'chapter-' + chapterId` - `badges()` → array - `markVisited(chapterId)` **`HRL_SHELL`** - `openChapter(chapterId)` - `openQuiz(chapterId)` - `showView(name)` / `showView(name, opts)` - `toast(message, kind)` — third arg optional, unused here - `renderHome()` — after a placement re-run - `on('viewchange', fn)` — disconnects the chapter progress observer when leaving the reader **`HRL_SVG`** - `HRL_SVG[builderName](opts)` → SVG string (`field`, `basePaths`, `strikeZone`, `countMatrix`, `sprayChart`, `scaleGauge`, …) - `BUILDERS` — name list, used only as a known-builder check **`HRL_MODAL`** - `open({ title, titleId, build: function (box, api) {} })` - `close()` - `api.el` inside `build` (falls back to the local `el()`) ### 6. Deviations - **Re-run placement** calls `HRL_PLACEMENT.start({ skippable: true, onComplete })` because `startPlacement` is not on `HRL_SHELL`’s public API. If placement is not loaded, it toasts instead of throwing. - **Chapter title focus** is deferred with `setTimeout(0)` so it wins over `shell.js` focusing the static view `

Chapter

` after `renderChapter`. - **Home/End** also move between tier heads, in addition to the required arrow keys. Enter/Space is native `
